name: MCP Tool Registry Normalization

test_list.description: A valid MCP input schema becomes normalized registry schema.
Malformed or invalid schemas are rejected with SchemaInvalid.
Unsupported assertion keywords fail closed rather than weakening argument validation.
Property names remain intact and nested property schemas normalize in schema context.
Literal JSON values are not recursively interpreted as schema objects.
Non-assertion annotations are removed and recorded for the registry dialect.
Recursive reference cycles are rejected without recursion overflow.
Identically named tools from different servers receive distinct stable IDs.
Listed tool effects remain conservative and caller authorization gates remote calls.

inputs.name: tool
inputs.description: Tool advertised by the remote server.

output_description: A namespaced, validated, bounded registry entry with conservative effects, or a typed schema error.
